meta.name: business-investment-advisor
meta.description: Business investment analysis and capital allocation advisor. Use when evaluating whether to invest in equipment, real estate, a new business, hiring, technology, or any capital expenditure. Also use for ROI calculations, IRR, NPV, payback period, build vs buy decisions, lease vs buy analysis, vendor evaluation, or deciding where to allocate limited budget for maximum return.

copy.tagline: 评估投资回报，优化资本配置决策
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果常需要计算投资回报率或比较不同花钱方案
copy.tagline_en: Evaluate investment returns and optimize capital allocation decisions
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often need to calculate ROI or compare spending options

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会变成一位商业投资分析师，帮你评估设备、招聘、软件、房地产等资本支出。它会计算ROI、回收期、NPV、IRR，给出推荐并提示风险。
howto.when: 当你询问是否购买某项资产、比较多个投资选项、或做自建vs购买、租赁vs购买、招聘vs自动化等决策时触发。

say.text: 我该不该买这台新设备？
比较一下租用和购买服务器哪个划算。
say.note: Claude会进行TCO对比和盈亏平衡分析。

say.text: 我有10万预算，应该优先投哪个项目？
say.note: Claude会按IRR排序并给出预算分配建议。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude becomes a business investment analyst. It evaluates capital expenditures like equipment, hiring, software, and real estate. It calculates ROI, payback period, NPV, IRR, gives recommendations, and flags risks.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask whether to buy an asset, compare multiple investment options, or make build vs buy, lease vs buy, hire vs automate decisions.

say_en.text: Should I buy this new equipment?
say_en.note: Claude will ask for cost and expected returns, then provide a full analysis.

say_en.text: Compare leasing vs buying a server.
say_en.note: Claude will do a TCO comparison and break-even analysis.

say_en.text: I have $100k budget, which project should I fund first?
say_en.note: Claude will rank by IRR and recommend allocation.
